comments.text:
Create a standalone native application that reuses the Vizia UI and integral-core logic, but runs outside a DAW with direct MIDI port access.

PURPOSE: Users who don't use a DAW (or want a dedicated control surface app) should be able to run Integral as a native app on macOS/Linux/Windows. This replaces the web app for users who prefer a native experience.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.13 (MixerPage — the Vizia UI must exist first)

APPROACH — nih-plug standalone:
nih-plug has a built-in standalone backend (nih_plug::wrapper::standalone). It opens a native window with the plugin's Vizia editor and provides audio/MIDI I/O via JACK or CoreAudio/CoreMIDI. This is the path of least resistance — no new code for windowing or UI hosting.

IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Add the standalone wrapper feature to integral-vst/Cargo.toml:
   nih_plug = { version = "...", features = ["standalone"] }
2. Add a binary target in integral-vst/Cargo.toml or a new crate (e.g. integral-standalone/):
   [[bin]]
   name = "integral"
   path = "src/standalone.rs"
3. The standalone binary is minimal — it calls nih_plug::wrapper::standalone::nih_export_standalone() which handles window creation, audio/MIDI backend, and the Vizia editor lifecycle
4. Add MIDI port selection: nih-plug standalone supports --midi-input and --midi-output CLI args, or the JACK port connection UI. For CoreMIDI (macOS), enumerate ports and connect to Integra-7 automatically (reuse the port detection logic from integral-cli)
5. Add to flake.nix: a standalone build target and a nix run command
6. Add to justfile: just run-standalone target

MIDI I/O DIFFERENCES FROM VST:
- In VST mode: MIDI comes from the DAW host via NoteEvent
- In standalone mode: MIDI comes from CoreMIDI/ALSA/JACK directly
- The integral-core DeviceState doesn't care — it just receives bytes and produces bytes
- The standalone wrapper needs to handle MIDI port enumeration and connection (similar to what integral-cli does with midir)

OPTIONAL ENHANCEMENTS (can be separate tasks):
- Auto-detect Integra-7 port by name (like the web app's findIntegraPort)
- System tray icon for background operation
- Remember last-used MIDI port

REFERENCE:
- nih-plug standalone docs: https://nih-plug.robbertvanderhelm.nl/nih_plug/wrapper/standalone/
- crates/integral-cli/src/main.rs: MIDI port enumeration with midir
- web/src/midi.ts: findIntegraPort() logic for auto-detection

TESTING: cargo run -p integral-vst --bin integral (or equivalent) should open a native window with the mixer UI, enumerate MIDI ports, and connect to the Integra-7.

title: Standalone: wrap VST plugin as a native macOS/Linux/Windows app with MIDI port selection
